g.text: On clean scenes with the locker after the pick, the locker sentences make the link
Clean one-pick scenes, locker after the pick, only the bridge token differs (n = 201 / 288 / 205
items on the 9B / 27B / Muse). Lookups switched (%), 95% intervals; the sweep after the data,
the rule's arms (filled) fixed in advance. The copy into the locker sentences rises from near 0:
they make the link by L on the Qwens, from about L/2 on Muse. Rule: the copy at L (or L/2)
switches at least half of the changed prompt's switches while the bridge-word change at L stays
at or below 0.25, on 2 of 3 models: holds, 3 of 3.
